parsed.rationale: The second participating record resides at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits inside an Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/ directory — a canonical sample-app subtree. Even though the is_sample_app flag reads false, the file path is dispositive under the decision rules: any record under Examples/ triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint. Extracting the shared DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator.next implementation into a common package would couple the production DebugPanel target to sample-app demonstration code, which is the precise anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent. The duplication here is intentional: the sample app maintains its own local copy of the display-link async iterator so it can be modified freely without affecting the production DebugPanel package.
